title: SpawnEggGuard
description: Tiny plugin to prevent using spawn eggs in spawners
body:
# Issues & Suggestions

Visit our [Discord](https://discord.gg/simplestudio) for any issues or suggestions!
___

Tiny plugin to prevent players from putting spawn eggs in spawners.

Entire plugin is toggleable and the message can be changed in config.yml

`/spawneggguard reload` to reload the config

`spawneggguard.admin` permission to use the reload command & to bypass the spawn egg check
